title: Writing at the suffix head
statement: For bit lists $u$ and $v$ and a bit $b$, updating the tape holding $u$ followed by $v$ at cell $|u|$ with the symbol $b$ yields the tape holding $u$ followed by $b$ and then the tail of $v$.
replaced: For bit lists $u$ and $v$ and a bit $b$, updating the tape that holds $u$ followed by $v$ at cell $|u|$ with the symbol $b$ yields the tape holding $u$ followed by $b$ and then the tail of $v$: the write either replaces the first suffix bit or extends the word, all other cells are unchanged, and negative cells stay blank.
